lifecycle.label: Offline fixture inspection

lifecycle.label: Release and chain binding
lifecycle.statement: There is no program ID or checked deployment identity for this client to validate.

lifecycle.label: Production source ingestion
lifecycle.statement: No admitted provider/parser release can construct a production authenticated source history.

lifecycle.label: Full coupled settlement
lifecycle.statement: Candidate selection, entitlement construction, lapse, refund, and terminal settlement remain incomplete as one lifecycle.

basisComparison.nativeDegreeZero: An exhaustive, disjoint, ordered partition of the admitted state domain.
basisComparison.nativeSmoothDegreesOneToThree: Not the smooth construction; exactly one native Egg receives full weight at an admitted realized state.
basisComparison.categoricalCompatibilityLowering: This is native categorical semantics, not a proxy for degrees one through three.

basisComparison.nativeDegreeZero: Not a one-hot outcome model; neighboring native Eggs may overlap around a resolved point.
basisComparison.nativeSmoothDegreesOneToThree: Open-clamped B-splines with overlapping local support, nonnegative exact weights, and partition of unity.
basisComparison.categoricalCompatibilityLowering: Lowering is a separately disclosed adapter with an error statement when inexact; it never renames or redefines the smooth product.

localFixtures.label: Bundled terms fixture r2

localFixtures.label: Native V1 degree-one fixture

boundaries.title: Browser authority
boundaries.text: No RPC, wallet, transaction, or background capability exists in this client.

boundaries.title: Native claim semantics
boundaries.text: Smooth degree-one through degree-three claims must never be silently lowered into degree-zero categories.

boundaries.title: Release and deployment
boundaries.text: No checked release manifest, program ID, ELF identity, public deployment, or official hosted client exists.

boundaries.title: Source provenance
boundaries.text: Production source creation, parser/provider admission, and Clock-bound history remain stopped; mock evidence is not a provider claim.

boundaries.title: Selection and settlement
boundaries.text: Narrow direct seams do not constitute an end-to-end candidate selection, entitlement, settlement, lapse, or refund lifecycle.

boundaries.title: Active native mode
boundaries.text: Focused native resolution evidence does not close mode binding across every active lifecycle seam.

boundaries.title: Prepaid liveness
boundaries.text: Collateral, cash, reservation, rent principal, prepaid work, and donations have separate accounting roles; future fees and Hoard principal never fund required work.

boundaries.title: ResolutionWork route boundary
boundaries.text: ResolutionWork has route-level local SBF evidence, but it does not establish production source release, terminal venue closure, deployment, or system-wide liveness.

boundaries.title: Direct selection boundary
boundaries.text: Direct Selection V2 remains STOP after measured rollback; Direct Selection V3 is MODEL-ONLY and allocates no live ABI or settlement affordance.

boundaries.title: Liveness evidence boundary
boundaries.text: The committed liveness ELF and bank logs are local evidence artifacts only; they do not close measured liveness, deployment, release, or inclusion gates.

boundaries.title: Scalar batch proof boundary
boundaries.text: The Verus shadow proves four mathematical statements under explicit premises; it is not a proof of production batch code, dust completion, coupled settlement, or SBF behavior.

boundaries.title: Terminal model boundary
boundaries.text: The internal-only terminal model fails closed on external bearers and has no live authority, account, token, rent-funding, migration, or fractional-credit transition.
